requirements.title: Monotonic Microsecond Time Source
requirements.description: The time library shall provide a monotonic time value expressed in microseconds since FSW startup.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-026; a monotonic microsecond counter is the canonical FSW time base for all records.

requirements.title: Non-Decreasing Time Values
requirements.description: The time library shall return time values that never decrease between successive queries.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-026 and SW-REQ-SYS-044; monotonicity is the deterministic property the system depends on.

requirements.title: Sixty-Four-Bit Counter Width
requirements.description: The time library shall represent the monotonic time value using a 64-bit unsigned integer.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-026; 64-bit width prevents wrap during the FT1 mission and any plausible future mission.

requirements.title: Per-Call Time Query Interface
requirements.description: The time library shall provide an interface returning the current monotonic time value on each call.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-027; per-record timestamping requires callers to query time at each sample event.

requirements.title: Bounded Query Latency
requirements.description: The time library shall return from a time query without blocking on I/O or scheduling.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044; cheap and deterministic time queries keep the TDM scheduler loop predictable.

requirements.title: POSIX Implementation Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The time library shall provide a POSIX implementation functionally equivalent to the Pico2 implementation.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; Trick simulation requires POSIX builds that exercise the same time API as flight.

requirements.title: Pico2 Implementation for Flight Hardware
requirements.description: The time library shall provide a Pico2 implementation returning monotonic microseconds from the on-board hardware time base.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; flight hardware build requires a Pico2 implementation paired with the POSIX implementation.
